preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**6 for line in stdin.splitlines() for x in line.split() if x.isdigit())
preconditions.description: All integers in input are within the bounds 1 ≤ n ≤ 10^6 and 0 ≤ m ≤ 10^6.
The input consists of exactly m + 1 lines: one line with n and m, followed by m lines of edges.
Each of the m edge lines contains exactly two integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(a) <= n and 1 <= int(b) <= n and int(a) != int(b) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for a, b in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each edge (a, b) satisfies 1 ≤ a, b ≤ n and a ≠ b.

preconditions.expression: len({(int(a), int(b)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for a, b in [line.split()]}) == m
preconditions.description: Alice's graph has no multiple edges or self-loops.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the total number of triangles in Alice's and Bob's graphs combined.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u < v < w <= n and ((u, v) in alice_edges or (u, v) in bob_edges) and ((v, w) in alice_edges or (v, w) in bob_edges) and ((u, w) in alice_edges or (u, w) in bob_edges) for u, v, w in triangles)
postconditions.description: For every triangle (u, v, w) counted in the output, all three edges (u, v), (v, w), and (u, w) must exist in either Alice's or Bob's graph, where bob_edges is the complement of alice_edges in the complete graph.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == sum(1 for u in range(1, n + 1) for v in range(u + 1, n + 1) for w in range(v + 1, n + 1) if ((u, v) in alice_edges or (u, v) in bob_edges) and ((v, w) in alice_edges or (v, w) in bob_edges) and ((u, w) in alice_edges or (u, w) in bob_edges))
postconditions.description: The output is the total number of triangles in Alice's and Bob's graphs combined, where a triangle is a set of three distinct vertices {u, v, w} such that all three edges (u, v), (v, w), and (u, w) exist in either Alice's or Bob's graph.

invariants.expression: alice_edges := {(int(a), int(b)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for a, b in [line.split()]}
invariants.description: alice_edges is the set of edges in Alice's graph, derived from the input.

invariants.expression: bob_edges := {(u, v) for u in range(1, n + 1) for v in range(u + 1, n + 1) if (u, v) not in alice_edges}
invariants.description: bob_edges is the set of edges in Bob's graph, which are all possible edges in the complete graph not present in Alice's graph.
n is the number of vertices in the complete graph, derived from the first line of input.
